description: Read newest editorial send ledger while runner active

steps.name: active-send-ledger
steps.script:
$d='C:\TTiTTulares\TT-Editorial-Rescue\sent'
$f=Get-ChildItem $d -Filter 'TTITTULARES_EDITORIAL_JOB_V2_*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
$s=if($f){Get-Content $f.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json}else{$null}
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+(@{state='ok';file=if($f){$f.Name}else{''};status=if($s){[string]$s.status}else{'none'};marker=if($s){[string]$s.marker}else{''}}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
